rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a material board-administration template: establish a presidentially appointed board, charge it with examining individual cases and advising the President, provide that members receive no additional compensation, and assign an existing department to furnish necessary support. The child adapts that machinery from clemency cases to federal civilian awards and elaborates the nomination and selection process. C08 and C13 share portions of the review, advisory, staffing, and uncompensated-service machinery, but their overall operative sequences are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established the Distinguished Civilian Service Awards Board ... which shall consist of five members, appointed by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established a Clemency and Parole Board for War Criminals ... The Board shall consist of three members, appointed by the President
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel establishment and presidential-appointment provision for a specifically named board.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall advise and assist the President in the selection of persons ... carefully review recommendations submitted to it ... and shall transmit to the President ... the names of those persons ... together with its reasons therefor.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Board shall make the necessary investigation in, and advise the President with respect to, those cases in which a decision of the Government of the United States is required
shared_material.explanation: Both boards examine individual cases or recommendations and advise the President, who retains the ultimate decision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The members of the Board shall serve as such without additional compensation ... the Civil Service Commission is requested to furnish the Board the necessary staff and other services.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: each member ... shall receive ... his compensation as an officer or employee of that department but shall receive no additional compensation by reason of service ... and the Department of State shall furnish the Board necessary accommodation and facilities.
shared_material.explanation: Substantially the same compensation and host-agency support machinery, adapted to the Civil Service Commission.
